wants.title: Tractor, 90-140hp, with front-end loader
must: known manufacturer: John Deere, Case, Kubota, New Holland, Massey Ferguson, McCormick, Kioti, Lovol or better
wants.notes: Build quality matters more than hours alone. A tidy 3,000-hour Deere beats a rough 1,500-hour no-name. Sweep the dealer used pages below as well as the auction and classifieds sites. farmmachinerysales.com.au blocks WebFetch and curl (403): open it in Chrome like Facebook, or skip it on a cloud run and say so in notes.

wants.title: Portable home, container or similar, 2+ rooms with bathroom
wants.notes: Price band tracks quality: 5k for a rough site hut, 30k for a finished container home. Transport cost is worth noting separately.

wants.title: Chainsaw, Stihl or Husqvarna, 30 inch bar capable
must: rated to carry a 30 inch bar (e.g. Stihl MS 462, MS 500i, Husqvarna 572 XP, 592 XP)
wants.notes: New MS 462 sits near the top of the band, so a clean used saw with a bar is the value play.

wants.title: Offset discs, 24-32 plate, for a 90-130hp tractor
prefer: plates with life left, not dished out
local within 400km, or an overseas maker that ships to Australia
wants.notes: Width is the hard constraint: anything over 3.5 m is too much for the tractor and too wide to cart. Overseas makers (e.g. made in China, Italy, Turkey, Brazil) count if they ship to Australia: quote price plus freight and import costs.

wants.title: Tree root ripper, ideally a single deep tyne
must: built for ripping tree roots: heavy shank, deep rip, not a general tillage or chisel ripper
prefer: local within 400km, or an overseas maker that ships to Australia
wants.notes: One deep, heavy tyne pulls deepest for the horsepower and is what root ripping needs; multi-tyne tillage rippers are out. Overseas makers (China, Italy, Turkey, NZ etc.) count if they ship to Australia: quote price plus freight and import costs, and mark distance as overseas.

wants.title: Drop deck trailer, 2001 or newer, $5,000 to $20,000
prefer: carry rating to suit a loader tractor
wants.notes: Base and radius assumed to match the tractor and implement wants; the carry rating preference is a guess at hauling a loader tractor, so say if it should be different.

wants.title: Stick rake for the Lovol P5130 front-end loader
must: loader-mounted stick rake (tine rake for timber, roots and debris), not a 3PL hay or landscape rake
fits the Lovol P5130 loader: Euro hitch, unless the dealer confirms a different quick hitch
prefer: about 2.0 to 2.4 m wide, no wider than the loader frame and front tyres
heavy box-section tines with replaceable or hardfaced tips
grapple or hold-down arm (only if the loader has a 3rd function)
wants.notes: Lovol P5130 is on loan from the dealer for a month or two, so the attachment has to fit that loader now. Confirm the hitch type and the loader's rated lift with the dealer before buying. New Australian-made stick rakes and imports both count; quote freight for anything posted.

wants.title: Pallet forks for the Lovol P5130 front-end loader
must: loader pallet fork frame with two tines
fits the Lovol P5130 loader: Euro hitch, unless the dealer confirms a different quick hitch
rated at least 1,000 kg at 500-600 mm load centre
prefer: tines about 1,000 to 1,200 mm long, adjustable spacing
load-rated to AS2359 with a rating plate
wants.notes: Lovol P5130 is on loan from the dealer for a month or two, so the forks have to fit that loader now. Confirm the hitch type and the loader's rated lift with the dealer; the forks' rating should not be far above the loader's. Benchmark: John Berends Euro hitch pallet forks (model 0298) from Pipeliner dealers.
